Subject: Kickoff: Supplier onboarding & ESG / Modern Slavery questionnaire — SustainWell

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the pilot — excited to get SustainWell set up. To move vendor setup through procurement and finance we need to complete a few onboarding artifacts so we can issue the first PO and enable invoicing. Can you please: 

- Review and complete the attached Supplier Questionnaire (sections on ESG, modern slavery, and supplier diversity) — we only need the highlighted pages for the first pass. (Attachment: SustainWell_Supplier_Questionnaire_PARTIAL.pdf)
- Confirm whether SustainWell has any supplier diversity certifications (minority-owned / women-owned / veteran-owned). If yes, attach supporting certs.
- Share your preferred invoice remit + bank details document (we will send our vendor information form via DocuSign when the questionnaire is complete).

Timing: if we can get the questionnaire back by EOD Thu (2026-03-05) procurement can create the PO to cover the March pilot fees. 

I've attached a short PO onboarding checklist and our Modern Slavery template for reference. Monica is looped for procurement specifics.

Thanks — let me know if any of the asks above are unclear.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0193

Attachments: SustainWell_Supplier_Questionnaire_PARTIAL.pdf (pdf, 5 pages - highlighted), Redwood_PO_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_Modern_Slavery_Template.docx

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Supplier onboarding & ESG / Modern Slavery questionnaire — SustainWell

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear list. Attaching our partially completed questionnaire (we filled the commercial and basic ESG sections) and flagged two items where we want to confirm Redwood's expectations:

1) Modern Slavery: you ask for subcontractor audits — we typically provide a summary statement rather than full subcontractor audit reports. Is a summary acceptable for initial onboarding?
2) Supplier diversity: we are certified as a Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB) in CA; I'll attach the certificate but it may take a day to find the official scan.

We'll aim to complete the remaining ESG narrative fields by Wednesday (2026-03-04). For bank details, we prefer to send via the DocuSign flow for security — can you trigger that once the questionnaire is approved?

Thanks,
Aisha O'Connor
Head of Procurement | SustainWell Inc.
aisha.oconnor@sustainwell.com | +1 312-555-4478

Aisha — appreciate the quick turnaround. Short answers below and next steps: 

- Modern Slavery subcontractor audits: for now a high-level summary of your subcontractor due-diligence approach and any recent findings is acceptable. We only require audit artifacts for escalated / higher-risk categories. I've attached our Modern Slavery template that shows the fields procurement will review (Redwood_Modern_Slavery_Template.docx).
- WOSB certification: great — please attach when available. That typically expedites preferred payment terms.

Next steps (action owners):
- SustainWell: finish the ESG narrative and attach WOSB cert (Aisha) — target: EOD Thu 2026-03-05.
- Redwood procurement: Monica to start the vendor profile in our system and prepare PO draft once the questionnaire is complete (Monica).
- Legal: Rishi will review any additional contract clauses if there are data residency or IP exceptions (Rishi).

Monica — can you confirm the PO timelines and whether we need additional tax forms (W-9 / W-8) from SustainWell?

Thanks,
Naomi

Hi all — quick procurement update: 

- We can draft a standard PO within 24 hours of receiving the completed questionnaire and certs.
- Tax forms: For US-based vendors we need a W-9. If SustainWell is international we'll need a W-8BEN-E. Please confirm country of registration in the questionnaire.
- Bank details: we'll send the vendor setup form via DocuSign once the questionnaire and tax form are received — that is our preferred, secure path.
- Payment terms: standard net-30, we can offer net-15 if you supply WOSB certification and standard insurance certificates.

Aisha — thanks for moving quickly. If you upload the final PDF to the Drive link Naomi shared, procurement will pick it up and start the PO workflow.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Sr. Procurement Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
